text: SHAMIR demo note: Genesis is the first book in the Torah/Pentateuch and is also the opening book of the Christian Old Testament. This note exists only to demonstrate retrieval and should not be treated as a scholarly citation.

SHAMIR demo note: The word Torah can refer broadly to teaching or instruction and, in a common canonical usage, to the first five books of the Hebrew Bible. Consult qualified linguistic and textual sources for detailed claims about Hebrew usage.

SHAMIR demo note: Biblical interpretation can involve linguistic, historical, literary, theological, and reception-history questions. Different interpretive traditions may reach different conclusions from the same passage.

SHAMIR demo note: Retrieval-Augmented Generation does not prove that a generated conclusion is correct. Retrieval quality, source quality, model behavior, and citation verification all need independent evaluation.
